name: Chezem
source:
[i]"...What? I'm trying to read a book here."[/i]
[i]Wise, but inexperienced? Intelligent and taciturn.[/i]

Master Chezem doesn't like people and noise very much, so he tends to stay in his room. He gets very adamant about things that interest him, and even looses sight of his surroundings. He's a bit of a scholarly type.

He has an inquiring mind, so he might be interested in an exotic person like you, milady.
